Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager

About the role
We're looking for a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own our retention and engagement programs across email, push, and in-app messaging. You will partner with Product, Data, and Design to grow customer lifetime value.

What you'll do
- Own the lifecycle strategy and roadmap for onboarding, activation, retention, and win-back journeys
- Build and optimize automated journeys in Braze, including segmentation and personalization
- Design and run A/B tests, analyze results with SQL, and share insights with executive stakeholders
- Partner cross-functionally with Product and Data Science to define KPIs and dashboards in Looker
- Manage a budget and report on ROI and LTV impact

What you'll need
- 5+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM marketing, or retention marketing
- Hands-on experience with Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io
- Strong SQL skills and experience with Looker or Tableau
- Proven experience with A/B testing and experimentation
- Excellent communication and storytelling skills
- Bachelor's degree required

Nice to have
- Experience in a subscription or marketplace business
- Familiarity with Amplitude
- Copywriting experience

Benefits
- Medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) match, unlimited PTO
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion.
